name: DNS C2 Kill Chain — NXDOMAIN Storm + Outbound Firewall Activity (v2)
alert_name: DNS C2 Kill Chain — NXDOMAIN Storm + Outbound Firewall Activity (v2)
description: Internal host with >=20 NXDOMAIN DNS responses in an hour that also opened outbound TCP sessions through the ASA in the same window - DGA cycling followed by successful egress. Replaces the original, which errored every run (suppression named a column its fields stage dropped) and filtered ASA dst_interface = "inside", i.e. inbound traffic, joined against the wrong end of the connection.
xql_query:
datamodel dataset = infoblox_infoblox_raw
| filter xdm.event.type = "DNS Response" and xdm.event.outcome_reason = "NXDOMAIN"
| filter xdm.source.ipv4 != null
| bin _time span = 60m
| comp count() as nxd_count by xdm.source.ipv4, _time
| filter nxd_count >= 20
| join type = inner (
    dataset = cisco_asa_raw
    | alter src_if   = _json -> generalCiscoLog.src_interface,
            dst_if   = _json -> generalCiscoLog.dst_interface,
            int_host = _json -> generalCiscoLog.src_ip,
            ext_host = _json -> generalCiscoLog.dst_ip
    | filter _raw_log contains "302014" and src_if = "inside" and dst_if = "outside"
    | comp count() as outbound_sessions, count_distinct(ext_host) as ext_peers by int_host
    | filter outbound_sessions >= 1
  ) as fw xdm.source.ipv4 = fw.int_host
| alter client_ip = xdm.source.ipv4
| fields client_ip, nxd_count, outbound_sessions, ext_peers
